dimensions.name: Input modality
dimensions.definition: Modalities actually supplied to this model request. OCR text is text; its source document does not make the request multimodal.

values.name: Text
values.definition: Readable text supplied to the model.
examples: A prompt containing extracted document text.

values.name: Image
values.definition: Images supplied to the model.
examples: A scanned page attached as an image.

values.name: Audio
values.definition: Audio supplied to the model.

values.name: Video
values.definition: Video supplied to the model.
examples: A clip supplied for event analysis.

dimensions.name: Required operation
dimensions.definition: Operations required by the request; multiple operations can apply. These are not industry use cases.

values.name: Classify
values.definition: Select among defined alternatives.

values.name: Extract
values.definition: Return information explicitly present in supplied evidence.

values.name: Summarize
values.definition: Condense supplied information while preserving relevant meaning.

values.name: Transform
values.definition: Change representation or language while preserving meaning.

values.name: Generate
values.definition: Create new content under stated requirements.

values.name: Calculate
values.definition: Perform numerical or symbolic operations.
examples: Compute a total from line items.

values.name: Apply rules
values.definition: Apply provided criteria to facts.

values.name: Reconcile evidence
values.definition: Compare sources and resolve or report inconsistencies.

values.name: Plan
values.definition: Choose dependent steps subject to constraints.
examples: Plan a sequence of service changes.

values.name: Create or modify code
values.definition: Produce executable code or configuration changes.

dimensions.name: Evidence scope
dimensions.definition: Where the information needed for the answer comes from; requirements may combine.

values.name: Supplied evidence
values.definition: Relevant material is already present in the request.
examples: Answer using the attached policy text.

values.name: Retrieval required
values.definition: Required information must be fetched from a source or tool.
examples: Look up the current order state.

values.name: Domain knowledge required
values.definition: The request expects knowledge beyond the supplied material.
examples: Explain a technical concept without reference text.

dimensions.name: Relationship between context items
dimensions.definition: How supplied items must be considered, independently of their length.

values.name: Single item
values.definition: One primary item provides the evidence.

values.name: Independent items
values.definition: Several items can be handled separately.
examples: Classify a list of unrelated tickets.

values.name: Cross-item reasoning
values.definition: The answer requires relating several items.

values.name: Stateful history
values.definition: Interpretation depends on prior events or state changes.
examples: Choose the next step after an unsuccessful tool action.

dimensions.name: Tool requirement
dimensions.definition: Required interaction with tools at this decision point, not whether previous calls used tools.

values.name: No tool required
values.definition: The request can be fulfilled without a tool.

values.name: Read external state
values.definition: Retrieve information without changing external business state.

values.name: Execute computation
values.definition: Run code or a calculation in a controlled environment.
examples: Run tests on a candidate patch.

values.name: Change external state
values.definition: Modify a record, send an action, or otherwise change external state.

dimensions.name: Output constraint
dimensions.definition: Constraints on the requested answer or action.

values.name: Free text
values.definition: No machine schema is specified.

values.name: Fixed choices
values.definition: Output must select defined choices.
examples: Choose one of four document types.

values.name: Structured schema
values.definition: Output must satisfy a specified machine-readable schema.
examples: Return JSON matching the supplied fields.

values.name: Evidence references
values.definition: Claims must cite source passages or records.
examples: Explain the result with document references.

values.name: Executable artifact
values.definition: The output must run or apply in a target environment.
